about:
# A NOTE ON THE MOD NAME
### the swearing in [this specific mod](mod:raydeeux_flingus.fuckthislevel) was approved by hjfod himself. anyone who takes issue with that should take several deep breaths before making angry (and permanent) social media posts.
# YouAreFuckMap

Now you can hate levels (and level lists) twice as harder than before! <c-aaaaaa>*[dubious claim, citation needed]*</c>

Also comes with individual counters for how many times you've "flung the bird" at a level/level list/comment/profile comment.

Original implementation by flingus. Sprites by Alphalaneous.

Revived after some nagging from the GDM Discord server.

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
